LedgeLOS.Name: Ledge LOS
LedgeLOS.Description: Works out whether two creatures can see each other across a vertical ledge. Enter the ledge height and each creature's size and position to get a clear, blocked, or conditional result.

ChallengeCalc.Name: PFS2 Challenge Calc
ChallengeCalc.Description: Organized Play table setup. Enter each character's level and any pregenerated characters to get total Challenge Points and whether the table plays the low or high level range of a scenario.

DowntimeIncome.Name: PFS2 SFS2 Downtime Income
DowntimeIncome.Description: Organized Play Earn Income helper for Pathfinder and Starfinder Society. Enter character level, skill proficiency, downtime days and the check result to get the income earned.
